text.p: Tropical Cyclone 07B crashed into the East Coast of India with damaging winds, a storm surge, and flooding rains. The storm came in just south of Cocanada with winds of 130 mph. This system will weaken very rapidly now that it is over land. It is expected to dissipate within 36 hours, but it will continue to produce heavy rains and flooding along its path. Rainfall amounts of 6-12 inches will occur along the path of the storm.

Tropical Cyclone Melanie-Bellamine is a very powerful storm with 120 mph top winds. The storm threatens only shipping in the southern Indian Ocean. It is centered near 13s/78e and tracking to the west southwest. It is expected to pick up foward speed and graudally weaken over the next 48 hours.

Typhoon Dale is moving to the west and will pass south of Guam this period, producing only wind/rain squalls in Guam. Dale will intensify and become a major threat to shipping as top winds reach or exceed 100 mph.
Tropical Storm Ernie produced heavy rain and local flooding in the southern Philippines. This system will move into the South China Sea and intensify, becoming a threat to shipping this period.
